title: I lost my cat…but then I found her
content: Hey everyone, I had a strange dream last night. I was in a new location, it was like an old hotel. I was frantically looking for my cat. I was looking in all the rooms and running around. I found a familiar cat, but it wasn’t her. After hearing her meow, I found her…in a toilet?! My poor kitty had fell in the toilet and was trapped in there. It was a very stressful dream. I wonder why she chooses to visit me in my dream world sometimes though, are we both astral projecting to the same place? I see other people I know there too, and I wonder if it is some version of them in an alternate reality.
